name: Motor Scooter
description: A nonpedal vehicle with a seat, two wheels, a step-through chassis, an automatic transmission and a motor rated 2.7 brake horsepower (2,025 W) or less, ridden no faster than 30 mph. An electric scooter-style moped without pedals lands here. Defined by Maryland Transportation Article §11-134.5 and regulated by §21-1205.1; it isn't a motor vehicle.

restrictions.rule: No pedals: a seat, two wheels (one 10 inches or more in diameter), a step-through chassis and an automatic transmission
A motor rated 2.7 brake horsepower (2,025 W) or less
Excludes vehicles manufactured for off-road use, such as an off-road motorcycle
May not be ridden faster than 30 mph
Riders need a driver's license of any class or a moped operator's permit
Every rider and passenger must wear a helmet meeting FMVSS 218, and the operator must wear approved eye protection unless it has a windscreen
Titled with the MVA, which issues a decal to display on it; the owner must certify at titling that it carries the required liability insurance
Must use a smooth-paved bike lane where there is one, keeping as far right as practicable when slower than traffic
Barred from roads posted above 50 mph except on their shoulders, and from expressways
